column1: # Anthropic first-party API list prices in microdollars per million tokens.
# A row applies to the model id exactly, or to the id with a trailing -YYYYMMDD snapshot suffix.
# speed "fast" rows are fast-mode base prices with the cache multipliers applied on top.
# Models 4.6 and later bill the full 1M context at these rates (no long-context premium).
# US-only inference (usage.inference_geo "us") multiplies every category by 1.1 on 4.6 and later.
